cohort: 96 primiparous women (24 who underwent cesarean delivery and 72 who had a vaginal birth)
finding: Pelvic floor muscle strength does not differ significantly between primiparous women based on the type of delivery.
mod_finding: Postpartum women with normal births, with higher education who performed perineal exercise during pregnancy showed greater muscle strength.
birth_weight: Mentioned, but specific weight not stated
